It holds a Zacks ETF Rank of 3 (Hold) and is considered a good option for investors seeking exposure to large-cap blend stocks, with alternatives like IVV and SPY also available.

title: We Energies plans to spend $335M on Microsoft development in Mount Pleasant
summary: We Energies plans to invest $335 million in a distribution project for Microsoft's data center development in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin, on land originally designated for Foxconn. Due to a 2017 law related to the Foxconn project, this substantial investment does not require approval from the Public Service Commission, raising concerns about oversight. Microsoft's data centers are highly energy-intensive, and there's a growing push to ensure residential customers are not burdened with the increased energy costs.

title: KT teams up with Amazon to bolster B2B generative AI
summary: South Korean telecom provider KT Corp. has partnered with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to enhance its B2B generative AI services, aiming to transform into an AI-focused ICT company. This collaboration involves developing generative AI based on Amazon Bedrock and offering cloud-based private 5G network services. KT plans to hire more AI and ICT experts, integrate AI into performance reviews, and upgrade its internal generative AI platform "Gen.AIDU" using various LLMs.

title: NANC ETF Tracking Democrat Stock Trades Beating S&P 500 on Tech Bets
summary: The Unusual Whales Democratic ETF (NANC), which tracks stock trades by Democrats in Congress, has outperformed the S&P 500 since its launch in February 2023, returning 30% compared to the S&P 500's 24%. This outperformance is largely attributed to its significant holdings in mega-cap tech stocks like Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, and Nvidia. In contrast, a similar ETF tracking Republican trades (KRUZ) has only gained about 15% over the same period.

title: NBA® 2K24: MyTEAM Available Worldwide on iOS and Android
summary: NBA® 2K24: MyTEAM, a free-to-download mobile game, is now available worldwide on iOS and Android, allowing players to synchronize their progress between console and mobile devices. This enables users to assemble their dream NBA lineups, play various MyTEAM modes, earn XP, and collect rewards on the go. The game features quality NBA 2K gameplay, stunning graphics, and compatibility with external controllers, offering a realistic NBA simulation experience.

title: Intel’s new Intel vPro platform to power the next generation of AI PCs
summary: Intel has launched its new Intel vPro platform, integrating Intel Arc GPUs and Intel Core 14th Gen CPUs, to accelerate artificial intelligence capabilities on personal computers. This platform aims to introduce the "AI PC" era, offering significant productivity gains and enhanced security features for businesses and educational institutions. Over 100 new device models from various partners will be powered by this technology.

title: Microsoft, Intel and AI Veteran, Merrie Williamson, to Join Equinix as Chief Customer and Revenue Officer
summary: Equinix, a global digital infrastructure company, has announced the appointment of Merrie Williamson as Executive Vice President and Chief Customer and Revenue Officer (CCRO), effective March 25. Williamson brings over 20 years of experience from leadership roles at Microsoft and Intel, where she focused on digital transformation and AI. In her new role, she will oversee Equinix's entire customer experience and go-to-market strategy, including sales, marketing, and regional management, with a focus on leveraging technology and partnerships for customer success.

title: About
summary: This page provides a biography of Matthew Ball, CEO of Epyllion and author of the national bestselling book "The Metaverse." It outlines his professional background, advisory roles, publications, and contact information, alongside testimonials from prominent figures in technology and media.

title: How Nvidia grew to a trillion-dollar company fueling the AI revolution
summary: Nvidia has grown into a nearly $3 trillion company by specializing in Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), which have become crucial for the artificial intelligence revolution. Initially used for gaming, GPUs' ability to perform concurrent calculations makes them ideal for AI, giving Nvidia a significant first-mover advantage and market dominance. The company's unique technology and supply chain have led to widespread adoption by major tech firms, with discussions emerging about potential shortages and the need for continued investment in chip manufacturing.

title: SPY ETF Reaches Record High Amid Nvidia-Fueled AI Rally—Key Chart Pattern to Watch
summary: The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) reached a record high, mirroring the S&P 500's surge driven by mega-cap technology stocks, particularly after Nvidia's strong earnings report. Nvidia, along with other AI-related companies like Microsoft and Broadcom, contributed significantly to the rally, highlighting the outsized influence of Magnificent Seven stocks within the SPY's portfolio. Investors should watch the SPY's rising wedge pattern for potential breakouts or breakdowns, which could signal future price movements.

title: Ecolab appoints Judson Althoff to Board of Directors
summary: Ecolab Inc. has appointed Judson Althoff, Microsoft’s chief commercial officer, to its Board of Directors, effective February 21, 2024. Althoff will serve as an independent director and a member of the Audit and Finance Committees, bringing his extensive experience in technology, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to support Ecolab's digital innovation and profitable growth. Ecolab leaders Christophe Beck and Dave MacLennan emphasized the value of Althoff's expertise in strengthening the board and driving strategic initiatives for the company.

title: Intel’s CEO Says AI Is the Key to the Company’s Comeback
summary: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger states that AI and renewed investment in cutting-edge manufacturing are crucial for the company's comeback, allowing it to become a leading supplier of AI chips. He announced a rebrand of Intel's foundry business with Microsoft as a major customer for its new manufacturing technology. Gelsinger expects Intel's 18A manufacturing process to compete with TSMC and highlights advancements like backside power and being first in line for next-generation lithography machines as key differentiators.

title: Ecolab Appoints Judson Althoff to Board of Directors
summary: Ecolab has appointed Judson Althoff, Microsoft’s chief commercial officer, to its board of directors, effective February 21, 2024. Althoff will serve as an independent director and a member of the Audit and Finance Committees, bringing extensive global leadership, sales, business, and executive experience in high technology to the board. His deep knowledge of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and the global technology ecosystem is expected to support Ecolab’s digital innovation and long-term profitable growth.

title: Palo Alto Networks loses over $30 billion in market cap, sends shockwaves throughout cyber market
summary: Palo Alto Networks experienced its largest one-day share drop, losing over $30 billion in market cap after cutting its annual billings forecast due to softer client spending and steep promotions. The company's new strategy involves offering up to six months of free services to customers and an aggressive marketing approach to encourage "platform consolidation," sparking concerns about a potential price war in the cybersecurity market. This move could significantly impact competitors, particularly smaller startups, and reshape the industry landscape.

title: DigitalOcean beats expectations under the helm of new CEO Paddy Srinivasan
summary: DigitalOcean Holdings Inc. exceeded earnings and revenue expectations for the last quarter and provided optimistic guidance for the current quarter, leading to a stock surge. The company, under new CEO Paddy Srinivasan, is strategically focusing on AI solutions for small businesses, utilizing its Paperspace platform to offer Nvidia H100 GPUs, and demonstrating strong growth in its annual revenue run rate and average revenue per customer. Despite a slowdown in growth in the final quarter, analysts believe AI will be a key strategy for rekindling growth under the new leadership.

title: Intel Launches World’s First Systems Foundry Designed for the AI Era
summary: Intel has launched Intel Foundry, positioning it as the world's first systems foundry for the AI era, and announced an expanded process roadmap including Intel 14A and specialized node evolutions. The company affirmed its "five-nodes-in-four-years" process roadmap is on track and highlighted significant customer momentum, including Microsoft choosing Intel's 18A process for a chip design, alongside strong support from ecosystem partners. Intel outlined its commitment to sustainability, aiming to be the industry's most sustainable foundry with goals for 100% renewable electricity, net-positive water, and net-zero waste by 2030, and net-zero Scope 1 & 2 GHG emissions by 2040.

title: Intel Launches World’s First Systems Foundry Designed for the AI Era
summary: Intel has launched Intel Foundry, positioning it as the world's first systems foundry tailored for the AI era, with an expanded process roadmap targeting leadership by the end of the decade. The company announced new process technologies, ASAT capabilities, key customer design wins including Microsoft, and strong support from ecosystem partners. Intel Foundry also emphasized its commitment to sustainability, aiming for 100% renewable electricity and net-zero emissions by specific target dates.

title: Rackspace Technology Aims to Double Revenue in India with Growing AI Adoption
summary: Rackspace Technology plans to double its revenue in India within two years, driven by the increasing adoption of AI and demand for private cloud solutions. The company, which already has 40% of its global workforce in India, will establish a data center in the country. Rackspace aims to leverage India's growing startup ecosystem and high cloud consumption to expand its presence and brand recognition, focusing on digital transformation and AI-enabled cloud services.

title: Microsoft subsidiary renews S.F. headquarters lease despite remote work policy
summary: GitHub, a Microsoft subsidiary, has renewed its 57,000-square-foot San Francisco headquarters lease for five more years at 275 Brannan St., despite maintaining a remote-first work policy. The company views these spaces as "Hubs" for collaboration and community events, marking a different approach compared to other Microsoft divisions that are reducing office footprints in San Francisco. This renewal reflects a broader trend of companies recognizing the value of physical interaction, even with remote work embraced.

title: Meta settles lawsuit over haptic feedback tech in Quest headsets
summary: Immersion, a company specializing in haptic feedback technology, has settled a lawsuit with Meta over Meta's use of touch-feedback in its Quest VR headsets. The settlement involves Meta licensing Immersion's patents for its hardware, software, VR, and gaming products, though the terms were not disclosed. Immersion has a history of pursuing patent infringement lawsuits against major tech companies like Microsoft, Sony, Apple, and Valve.

title: Nvidia replaces Alphabet as Wall St's third most valuable company
summary: Nvidia has surpassed Google-parent Alphabet to become the third most valuable U.S. company, with a market capitalization of $1.825 trillion. This milestone follows its recent overtaking of Amazon, driven by strong investor interest in the dominant AI chipmaker ahead of its upcoming quarterly report. Nvidia's stock has surged due to its control of about 80% of the high-end AI chip market and strong demand for its products.

title: Akamai extends its edge-computing platform as it looks to challenge AWS, Azure and GCP
summary: Akamai has launched its Gecko "Generalized Edge Compute" platform, expanding its cloud-computing network with 10 new regions in Q1 and another 75 throughout the year. This initiative aims to bring compute capacity closer to users, reducing latency and enabling new use cases, directly challenging major cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and GCP. The company plans to open hundreds of small regions in the coming years and integrate its container service and automated workload platform.

title: Pega Unveils GenAI Blueprint to Automate Enterprise-Grade Workflow App Designs
summary: Pegasystems Inc. has introduced Pega GenAI Blueprint, a collaborative application leveraging generative AI and Pega's industry expertise to streamline enterprise workflow application design. The platform aims to transform app ideas into interactive "application blueprints" that are easily understood and collaborated on by stakeholders, moving beyond just code generation to focus on optimized workflow designs and decisions. This solution helps accelerate the journey from idea to implementation, fostering better collaboration and enabling rapid app deployment.

title: AI frenzy puts Nvidia briefly ahead of Amazon in market value
summary: Nvidia briefly surpassed Amazon.com in market capitalization on Monday, driven by the ongoing euphoria around artificial intelligence. The chipmaker reached a record high of $734.96, giving it a market value of $1.82 trillion, slightly ahead of Amazon's $1.81 trillion. This event marks Nvidia's highest valuation relative to Amazon since 2002, with investors keenly awaiting its upcoming quarterly results on February 21st.

title: Cisco Delivers 800Gbps on Amitié Transatlantic Cable in Collaboration with Microsoft
summary: Cisco and Microsoft successfully conducted an 800Gbps transmission trial on the Amitié transatlantic cable, spanning 6,234 kilometers from Boston to Bordeaux. This achievement supports the escalating demand for increased subsea network capacity driven by the growth of cloud and AI services. The trial utilized Cisco’s NCS 1014 platform with Acacia’s Coherent Interconnect Module 8, setting a new performance benchmark for SDM subsea cables.

title: Nvidia Overtakes Amazon in Market Value
summary: Nvidia briefly surpassed Amazon in market value, making it the fourth most valuable US-listed company earlier in the day. The chipmaker's rally, driven by exploding demand for AI chips, has seen its shares jump 46% this year. While Nvidia closed slightly below Amazon's valuation, the event marks a significant milestone fueled by the AI boom.

title: Vistra Corp (NYSE:VST) Surges Amidst AI Energy Boom and Nuclear Expansion
summary: Vistra Corp (NYSE:VST) has seen its stock surge over 200% year-to-date, fueled by the increasing demand for power from AI and data centers, as well as strategic expansions in nuclear energy. The company's acquisition of Energy Harbor significantly boosted its nuclear capacity, and its strong financial performance, insider confidence, and alignment with clean energy policies position it for continued growth, with analysts maintaining a bullish outlook.

title: Exclusive: Cisco to cut thousands of jobs as it seeks to focus on high growth areas
summary: Cisco is reportedly planning to restructure its business, which will involve laying off thousands of employees to focus on high-growth areas. An announcement could come as early as next week, ahead of its earnings call on Feb. 14. This move follows a previous restructuring in late 2022 and comes as many other tech companies are also cutting jobs.

title: Effective integration key to creating trusted data
summary: Proper data integration is essential for organizations to deliver trusted data, which enables data-driven decision-making and faster growth. Despite this, many enterprises struggle with analytics tool complexity, data literacy, and a lack of trust in their data. Dan Pitre of Actian emphasizes that cloud data platforms must prioritize data quality and ensure data is properly integrated and treated throughout its lifecycle to build confidence and facilitate the creation of a "single source of truth."

title: The 3 Best ETFs to Beat the S&P 500 Through 2030
summary: This article identifies three ETFs poised to outperform the S&P 500 by 2030, emphasizing their low expense ratios, strong historical performance, and alignment with emerging trends. The recommended ETFs are the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH), Invesco S&P 500 Quality ETF (SPHQ), and Invesco S&P MidCap Momentum ETF (XMMO), each offering unique advantages for investors seeking growth and stability.

title: Alphabet's First Dividend: What You Need to Know
summary: Alphabet has announced its first-ever quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share, payable on June 17 to shareholders of record as of June 10. While the initial dividend yield will be modest at approximately 0.5%, the company also authorized $70 billion in share repurchases. This move makes Alphabet one of the eight largest US companies by market capitalization to pay a quarterly dividend, alongside a significant share repurchase program.

title: 4 Undervalued Semiconductor Stocks
summary: Despite the AI boom driving up semiconductor stock prices, Morningstar analysts have identified four undervalued semiconductor stocks: Infineon Technologies, STMicroelectronics, MediaTek, and Skyworks Solutions. While digital chipmakers are largely overvalued due to AI, analog/mixed-signal chip valuations are still below fair value estimates. These top picks are favored for their strong positions in automotive semis, leadership in silicon-carbide, expansion into new markets, and essential RF products for mobile devices.

title: AMD Q1 Earnings Preview: Analysts Bullish, But Warn Of Factors That 'Can Derail The Semiconductor Industry'
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) is set to release its Q1 earnings, with analysts expecting revenue of $5.46 billion and earnings of 61 cents per share. While many analysts are bullish due to strong AI MI300 and EPYC performance, they also highlight risks such as market share declines, intense competition, and macroeconomic uncertainties that could impact the semiconductor industry. AMD shares have performed well over the last year, but some analysts have adjusted price targets ahead of the report.

title: 2024 Beijing Auto Show: WeRide's four major products officially debut.
summary: WeRide, a leader in autonomous driving technology, unveiled four core products at the 2024 Beijing Auto Show, including a L2++ mass-produced car, Robotaxi, Robobus, and an autonomous road sweeper. The company showcased these products and offered test rides, highlighting its advanced development capabilities and contributions to the intelligent driving industry. WeRide also emphasized its collaboration with Bosch and the commercial operation success of its autonomous taxi and minibus in various cities.

title: UMC reports lowest profit in three years
summary: United Microelectronic Corp (UMC) reported its lowest net profit in nearly three years in the first quarter, at NT$10.46 billion, due to prolonged inventory correction. However, the company anticipates a 3 percent increase in wafer shipments for the current quarter, driven by improving demand in communication and computer devices. UMC maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook for the year, expecting to outperform the global foundry industry and forecasting global semiconductor industry growth of about 5 percent, largely led by AI servers.

title: Nvidia acquires GPU cluster optimization startup Run:ai for reported $700M
summary: Nvidia Corp. has acquired Run:ai, a startup specializing in software that optimizes the performance of graphics card clusters for AI workloads. Although the terms were not officially disclosed, the deal was reportedly valued at $700 million, significantly higher than Run:ai's prior funding. Run:ai's technology aims to boost AI performance by resolving common inefficiencies in GPU-powered servers, such as data exchange delays and memory collisions, allowing for more efficient utilization of GPU resources.

title: US chip giant Nvidia snaps up Israeli AI workload management startup
summary: Nvidia has acquired Run:ai, an Israeli startup specializing in AI workload management software, for an estimated $600-$700 million. This acquisition marks Nvidia's largest in Israel since its 2020 purchase of Mellanox Technologies. Run:ai's co-founders and employees will join Nvidia's expanding R&D operations in Israel, aiming to enhance the efficiency of AI computing resources for customers across various infrastructure environments.

title: Serve Robotics Hauls In $40M and Prepares to Put 2,000 Robots on Streets
summary: Serve Robotics has raised $40 million, bringing its total fundraising to $93 million since 2021, and plans to deploy 2,000 robots in new markets by the end of 2025. The company aims to expand operations in Los Angeles and enter new cities like Dallas, San Diego, and Vancouver, having formalized a partnership with Magna International for manufacturing. Serve highlights safety, labor savings, and adorability as key value propositions, with CEO Dr. Ali Kashani expressing confidence in scalability despite being in early pre-revenue stages.

title: NVIDIA to Acquire GPU Orchestration Software Provider Run:ai
summary: NVIDIA announced its definitive agreement to acquire Run:ai, a Kubernetes-based workload management and orchestration software provider. This acquisition aims to help customers optimize their AI computing resources across various environments, with NVIDIA continuing to invest in Run:ai's product roadmap and integrate its capabilities with NVIDIA's AI platforms. The acquisition will enable better GPU utilization and improved management for customers leveraging NVIDIA's accelerated computing platform.

title: Cadence emulator and prototyping duo can handle up to 48 billion gate SoCs
summary: Cadence Design Systems has introduced its third-generation Palladium Z3 emulation and Protium X3 FPGA prototyping systems, offering significant capacity and performance improvements for advanced SoC development. These systems can handle designs from 16 million up to 48 billion gates, enabling comprehensive testing of large SoCs. Powered by Nvidia's BlueField DPU and Quantum InfiniBand, the solutions are designed to accelerate hardware verification and software validation, especially for AI, automotive, and hyperscale applications.

title: Microsoft CEO to meet with Samsung, SK Hynix, LG, SK Telecom chiefs
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and founder Bill Gates will meet with leaders of Samsung, SK Hynix, LG, and SK Telecom at the MS CEO Summit 2024 in May to discuss strengthening AI partnerships. The meetings aim to explore joint development of AI chips, cooperation in AI technology for consumer electronics, and business tie-ups in 5G telecommunications and cloud sectors. This gathering signifies an increasing trend of Big Tech firms seeking AI business collaborations to gain a competitive edge.

title: Akamai Launches Cloud Infrastructure and Services Powered by NVIDIA for Enhanced Video Processing
summary: Akamai Technologies has launched a new media-optimized cloud offering leveraging NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada Generation GPUs to enhance video processing for the media and entertainment industry. This service aims to provide significantly faster encoding and transcoding compared to traditional CPU-based methods, offering scalable and reliable architectures for various demanding workflows. Beyond media, the GPUs are also applicable to generative AI/ML, data analysis, scientific computing, gaming, and high-performance computing.

title: Super Micro Computer stock crashes 23%, drags down AI darling Nvidia after it doesn't preannounce earnings
summary: Super Micro Computer stock plunged 23% after the company announced its Q3 earnings date without a preannouncement, unlike last year. This lack of a positive preannouncement sparked investor concerns about the strength of its upcoming results. The decline also impacted Nvidia, whose chips are used in Super Micro's servers, causing its stock to fall by about 10%.

title: TSMC Accelerates Nearshoring to Diversify Away from China
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) is significantly expanding its manufacturing presence in the United States, increasing its investment from $40 billion to $65 billion, primarily in Phoenix, Arizona. This strategic move, supported by $6.6 billion in U.S. government subsidies, aims to decentralize chip production away from Taiwan, enhance U.S. technological sovereignty, and create thousands of jobs. The expansion reflects a broader industry trend towards nearshoring and diversifying supply chains to mitigate geopolitical risks and reduce reliance on Asian markets for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

title: Cisco Reimagines Security for Data Centers and Clouds in Era of AI
summary: Cisco has unveiled Hypershield, a new security architecture designed to protect data centers and clouds in the era of AI. This innovation allows for security placement anywhere it's needed, providing AI-native security capabilities such as autonomous network segmentation and distributed exploit protection. Cisco Hypershield aims to tip the scales in favor of defenders against sophisticated AI-driven cyber threats, leveraging hardware acceleration and cloud-native technologies like eBPF.

title: 4 Undervalued Semiconductor Stocks
summary: Amidst the AI boom led by Nvidia, Morningstar analysts identify Infineon Technologies, STMicroelectronics, MediaTek, and Skyworks Solutions as undervalued semiconductor stocks. The article discusses the varying valuations between digital and analog chipmakers, highlighting the robust demand for AI-related semiconductors versus the mixed recovery in non-AI sectors like automotive, industrial, and personal electronics. It provides detailed reasons for each company's valuation and market position.

title: SiTime Continues to Advance Precision Timing with an Integrated Clock Chip for AI Datacenters
summary: SiTime Corporation introduced its Chorus™ family of clock generators designed for AI datacenter applications. This new MEMS-based clock-system-on-a-chip (ClkSoC) family offers 10X higher performance in half the size compared to traditional standalone oscillators and clocks, integrating all necessary timing components into a single chip. The solution aims to simplify system architecture, accelerate design time, and address issues like noise and impedance matching, providing significant benefits for datacenter equipment.

title: Cadence Supercharges Chip Debug And Prototyping With Palladium Z3 And Protium X3 Systems
summary: Cadence Design Systems has launched its new Palladium Z3 and Protium X3 systems, designed to significantly enhance chip debugging and advanced prototyping. The Palladium Z3 offers 1.5 times the performance and double the capacity of its predecessor for pre-silicon debugging, while the Protium X3, built with AMD Versal Premium VP1902 adaptive SoCs, provides 1.5 times faster performance and triple the capacity for advanced physical prototyping. These systems are crucial for accelerating the development of complex chips in the AI era, with general availability expected in Q3 2024.

title: Intel Builds World’s Largest Neuromorphic System to Enable More Sustainable AI
summary: Intel has developed Hala Point, the world's largest neuromorphic system, featuring 1.15 billion neurons and 1,152 Loihi 2 processors to address the efficiency and sustainability challenges of AI. Deployed at Sandia National Laboratories, this system aims to advance brain-inspired AI research and future real-time continuous learning for various applications. It achieves state-of-the-art computational efficiencies, rivaling and exceeding GPU and CPU architectures, and promises significant energy savings for future AI deployments.

title: AMD and Nvidia unveil new processors for AI PCs
summary: AMD and Nvidia have both launched new processors designed for AI PCs, aiming to capitalize on the growing market for computers capable of running AI workloads on-device. AMD introduced its Ryzen PRO 8040 and 8000 Series processors, emphasizing their AI-enabled features for business users, while Nvidia unveiled new RTX A400 and A1000 GPUs with enhanced Tensor and RT Cores for accelerating AI and graphics tasks. This move by both companies highlights the intensifying competition in the AI PC sector, which analysts predict will drive new growth in the overall PC market.

title: Like Nvidia Stock but Prefer ETFs? This Is the Best Semiconductor ETF to Invest In Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Other Megatrends.
summary: The VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) is highlighted as an excellent option for investors seeking exposure to the semiconductor industry and megatrends like AI, vehicle electrification, and autonomous driving, while mitigating the risk of investing in individual stocks like Nvidia (NVDA). The ETF has Nvidia as its largest holding, accounting for 20% of its portfolio, and has significantly outperformed the S&P 500 over various timeframes due to its focus on the robustly growing chip market. It provides diversification across the semiconductor value chain, including chip producers, foundries, and equipment manufacturers.

title: Cohesity completes late-stage $150M funding from IBM and Nvidia, expands IBM partnership
summary: Data management provider Cohesity Inc. has completed a $150 million Series F funding round with participation from IBM and Nvidia Corp., bringing its total raised to $955 million. The funding coincides with an expanded partnership with IBM, focusing on cyber resilience capabilities within hybrid cloud environments. This collaboration integrates Cohesity DataProtect into IBM Storage Defender to enhance data protection, monitoring, management, and recovery against cyberthreats.

title: TSMC Arizona and U.S. Department of Commerce Announce up to US$6.6 Billion in Proposed CHIPS Act Direct Funding, the Company Plans Third Leading-Edge Fab in Phoenix
summary: TSMC Arizona and the U.S. Department of Commerce have signed a preliminary memorandum for up to US$6.6 billion in CHIPS Act direct funding. TSMC plans to build a third advanced semiconductor fab in Phoenix, Arizona, bringing its total investment in the site to over US$65 billion. This expansion aims to enhance U.S. semiconductor manufacturing capabilities and create thousands of high-tech jobs, with production from the three fabs utilizing 4nm, 2nm, and more advanced processes.

title: Alger Concentrated Equity ETF Holdings
summary: This article details the holdings of the Alger Concentrated Equity ETF (CNEQ), which was created on April 5, 2024. The ETF focuses on large-cap companies with high growth potential, maintaining a concentrated portfolio of no more than 30 stocks. The reported holdings include major technology companies like NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Amazon, alongside others across various sectors.

title: Should You Invest in the Invesco AI and Next Gen Software ETF (IGPT)?
summary: The Invesco AI and Next Gen Software ETF (IGPT) offers broad exposure to the Technology - Software segment, particularly in AI and next-gen software development. Launched in 2005, it is passively managed with an expense ratio of 0.60% and currently holds a Zacks ETF Rank of 1 (Strong Buy). Its top holdings include Meta Platforms, Nvidia, and Advanced Micro Devices, and it has shown strong year-to-date performance.

title: Leading chipmaker TSMC evacuates staff and pauses some machinery after Taiwan's largest earthquake in a quarter-century
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), the world's largest advanced chipmaker, and its rival United Microelectronics Corp. (UMC) halted some machinery and evacuated staff after Taiwan experienced its strongest earthquake in 25 years. The 7.4 magnitude temblor raised concerns about the semiconductor supply chain's vulnerability, given Taiwan's critical role in producing high-end chips. TSMC shares slid about 1.5% and UMC less than 1% in early trading following the event.

title: Lowe’s looks to Nvidia and AI to improve its retail operations
summary: Lowe's is partnering with Nvidia to integrate AI across its retail operations, including digital businesses, supply chain, and in-store experiences. The collaboration aims to enhance customer interactions, empower associates, and optimize store management through technologies such as AI-powered visualizations, digital twins in Nvidia Omniverse, and computer vision for checkout efficiency. Lowe's has been leveraging AI for years and sees ripe applications for the technology in improving both business processes and customer satisfaction.

title: 5 Best Momentum ETFs To Buy
summary: This article discusses momentum investing and lists five top momentum ETFs to consider buying, including the JPMorgan U.S. Momentum Factor ETF (JMOM). It highlights JMOM's structure, holdings, and performance, featuring NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) as a key holding. The article also touches on analyst insights and hedge fund sentiment regarding NVIDIA.

title: POET Enters Optical Module Market with 800G Transceiver for Artificial Intelligence Networks
summary: POET Technologies Inc. announced its entry into the optical module market with the Wavelight™, an 800G pluggable transceiver designed for artificial intelligence and cloud data centers. This marks a significant commercial milestone for the company, showcasing its POET Optical Interposer™ technology. The Wavelight modules will be debuted at OFC 2024, with customer sampling beginning in Q3 2024, targeting a rapidly growing market for high-speed transceivers.

title: FTEC: Concentration Increases Volatility (NYSEARCA:FTEC)
summary: The Fidelity MSCI Information Technology Index ETF (FTEC) offers strong tech exposure, performing similarly to VGT. However, 45% of its assets are concentrated in Microsoft, Apple, and NVIDIA, which could lead to increased volatility despite a projected 7% upside by year-end 2024. The author, Ricardo Fernandez, highlights the importance of an investor's goals and definition of "tech" when choosing an ETF.

title: What’s Inside Direxion’s Daily Semiconductor Bull and Bear 3x shares?
summary: This article describes the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull (SOXL) and Bear 3X Shares (SOXS) ETFs. title: 3 ETFs That Could Turn Your Portfolio Into a Tech Powerhouse
summary: This article recommends three ETFs to create a diversified tech portfolio, moving beyond reliance on "Magnificent 7" mega-caps. It highlights the iShares U.S. Medical Devices ETF (IHI) for healthcare tech, the SPDR Portfolio S&P 600 Small Cap ETF (SPSM) for overlooked small-cap tech, and the iShares Global Tech ETF (IXN) for international exposure. The author emphasizes diversification to mitigate risks associated with concentrated tech holdings and inflated valuations.

title: Lenovo Vehicle Computing, WeRide Forge Partnership For Autonomous Driving Solutions
summary: Lenovo Vehicle Computing and WeRide have partnered to develop Level 4 autonomous driving solutions for commercial applications. The collaboration will leverage Lenovo's AD1 domain controller, based on the NVIDIA DRIVE Thor platform, and integrate it into WeRide One, a versatile autonomous driving solution. This partnership aims to deliver enhanced autonomous driving products and services globally, focusing on safe and reliable commercial autonomous vehicles.

title: SAP and NVIDIA to Accelerate Generative AI Adoption Across Enterprise Applications Powering Global Industries
summary: SAP and NVIDIA have expanded their partnership to accelerate the adoption of generative AI across SAP's cloud solutions and applications. This collaboration aims to integrate business-specific generative AI capabilities into SAP's Joule copilot and other cloud offerings, leveraging NVIDIA's generative AI foundry services and NIM microservices to fine-tune large language models (LLMs) and enhance data insights. The new integrated capabilities are expected to be available by the end of 2024, enabling customers to automate tasks, improve human resources, and optimize business processes using AI.

title: NVIDIA’s AI models to be deployed on NXP’s edge processing devices portfolio
summary: NXP Semiconductors has announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to enable the deployment of NVIDIA's trained AI models on NXP's edge processing devices through the eIQ machine learning development environment. This integration simplifies the training and deployment of AI models for developers by incorporating the NVIDIA TAO Toolkit into NXP's eIQ environment. The company's database services, including Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Database 23ai, offer flexible intercloud and multicloud deployment choices, enabling customers to leverage various data and application development models for enterprise data and AI workloads. Oracle Database is lauded for its rapid pace of innovation and industry-leading multicloud capabilities, now available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

title: Microsoft and OpenAI evolve partnership to drive the next phase of AI
summary: Microsoft and OpenAI are continuing their strategic partnership, focusing on future AI developments and Stargate. The agreement, valid through 2030, maintains Microsoft's access to OpenAI's IP, revenue sharing, and exclusivity on OpenAI's APIs. Microsoft remains a major investor, while OpenAI has made a new, significant Azure commitment, and the exclusivity on new capacity has shifted to a right of first refusal for Microsoft.

title: KULR Technology Rallies After Licensing Deal For Nuclear Technology: Retail Chatter Lights Up
summary: KULR Technology Group Inc. shares surged by about 10% after it secured a multi-million dollar licensing deal to provide advanced cathode fiber applications for nuclear reactors in Japan, enhancing reactor safety and integrity. The company's technology is expected to address the increasing power demand from AI data centers, with retail sentiment largely bullish on the stock's growth potential. This comes after KULR's earlier decision to allocate up to 90% of its surplus cash to Bitcoin.

title: Markets Brief: Why Good News Can Be Bad News for Stock Investors
summary: US stock prices fell following stronger-than-expected employment numbers, highlighting investor concerns that positive economic news could lead to stickier inflation and fewer interest rate cuts in 2025. This downturn, particularly affecting high-growth technology companies whose valuations are sensitive to discount rates, suggests that value stocks may be better positioned. Upcoming inflation data and Taiwan Semiconductor earnings are expected to influence market volatility.

title: HPE secures $1 bln AI server deal for Elon Musk's X, Bloomberg News reports
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has secured a deal exceeding $1 billion to supply AI-optimized servers to Elon Musk's social media platform X. The agreement, reported by Bloomberg News, was finalized late last year. HPE's competitors, Dell Technologies and Super Micro Computer, also reportedly bid for the contract, highlighting the strong demand for AI servers from companies like Musk's X, Tesla, and xAI.

title: Blackstone Invests $300 Million In AI Data Firm That Powers Elon Musk's xAI Supercomputer
summary: Blackstone has invested $300 million in DDN, an AI data storage and analysis firm, marking its first external funding and valuing the company at $5 billion. DDN, founded in 1998, provides essential computing equipment and software for AI model training and deployment and powers Elon Musk's xAI supercomputer, Colossus. This investment aligns with Blackstone's broader AI strategy and comes amidst significant capital influx into AI infrastructure by major tech companies.

title: Getty announces plans to merge with Shutterstock in $3.7B deal
summary: Visual media behemoths Getty Images Holdings Inc. and Shutterstock Inc. have declared their intention to merge, forming a single visual content company valued at approximately $3.7 billion. The combined entity will operate under the Getty Images name, integrating the extensive portfolios of both firms, and its shares will continue to trade on the New York Stock Exchange as "GETY". This merger is strategically timed to capitalize on the increasing demand for compelling visual content and the burgeoning generative artificial intelligence market.

title: This Chinese AI Stock Is Preparing for ‘Explosive Growth’ in 2025. Is It Too Late to Buy?
summary: Baidu, often referred to as the "Google of China," is rapidly transforming into an AI powerhouse, with its ERNIE Bot and Apollo autonomous driving platform gaining significant traction. Despite a challenging macroeconomic environment impacting its online marketing revenue, Baidu is heavily investing in AI, reporting strong growth in AI Cloud revenue and high user engagement with its generative AI content. Analysts project substantial sales and earnings growth, with the stock currently valued at an attractive multiple, suggesting significant upside potential.

title: Ambiq and ThinkAR Disrupt the AR Glasses Industry with the AiLens
summary: Ambiq and ThinkAR have partnered to launch AiLens, a lightweight pair of smart AR glasses designed for everyday wear. These glasses weigh only 37 grams, offer over 10 hours of battery life, and are powered by Ambiq's ultra-efficient Apollo4 System-on-Chip (SoC) and ThinkAR's advanced AI capabilities. AiLens aims to redefine the AR glasses market with features like an AI-powered personal assistant, real-time language translation, and seamless integration with various platforms.

title: Intel Extends Leadership in AI PCs and Edge Computing at CES 2025
summary: At CES 2025, Intel unveiled new Intel Core Ultra (Series 2) processors, including the 200V series with Intel vPro for businesses, and 200HX and H series for creators and gamers, all featuring cutting-edge AI enhancements and performance improvements. Intel also introduced a new suite of processors for edge computing, showcasing significant performance gains in AI workloads compared to previous generations and competitors. The availability of these new systems is set to begin in January and February 2025, with further releases planned for the first half of the year.

title: NVIDIA Launches AI Foundation Models for RTX AI PCs
summary: NVIDIA announced the launch of foundation models for RTX AI PCs, designed to power digital humans, content creation, productivity, and development. These models, offered as NVIDIA NIM microservices, are accelerated by new GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs, featuring significant AI performance and supporting FP4 compute for enhanced inference. NVIDIA is collaborating with top PC manufacturers to integrate these NIM-ready RTX AI PCs, emphasizing the company's commitment to advancing AI accessibility for developers and enthusiasts.

title: HP Inc. Unleashes New AI PCs At CES 2025, Wins Three Innovation Awards
summary: HP Inc. unveiled a new lineup of AI-powered PCs at CES 2025, winning three innovation awards for devices like the Omnibook Ultra Flip and its embedded AI Companion. The company is targeting various user types, from entry-level workers to on-the-go executives, with new models such as the OmniStudio X Series, EliteBook Ultra, and EliteBook X, all featuring enhanced NPUs and AI capabilities. HP emphasizes its commitment to providing tools that boost productivity, creativity, and connectivity for every user.

title: Cybersecurity pioneer, tech CEO Amit Yoran dies 'unexpectedly' amid cancer battle
summary: Amit Yoran, the CEO of Tenable Holdings and a prominent figure in cybersecurity, has died unexpectedly at 54 after a battle with cancer. Yoran was a visionary leader, having also founded the U.S. Computer Emergency Readiness Team (US-CERT) program at the Department of Homeland Security. His leadership transformed Tenable into a global leader in exposure management, and his contributions to the cybersecurity field are described as indelible.

title: Morgan Stanley Moves Forward on Homegrown AI
summary: Morgan Stanley has deployed its second generative AI application, "AI @ Morgan Stanley Debrief," to its financial advisers. This new tool, developed in-house with OpenAI, summarizes video meetings and drafts follow-up emails, aligning with the company's preference for homegrown solutions over external tech provider tools. This follows the successful 2023 rollout of their AI knowledge assistant.

title: Trimble Unveils Reality Capture Platform Service
summary: Trimble has launched its Reality Capture Platform Service, an extension of Trimble Connect, enabling secure sharing and collaboration on reality capture datasets from 3D laser scanning, mobile mapping, and UAV systems. This platform facilitates collaboration among various professionals across numerous industries, enhancing data accessibility and workflow efficiencies between the jobsite and office. The service leverages Microsoft Azure Data Lake Storage and Synapse Analytics for efficient data processing, aiming to transform scanning workflows and accelerate the realization of digital twins and AI applications.

title: ServiceNow Introduces Workflow Data Fabric, Forging a New Generation of AI-fueled Productivity for the Enterprise
summary: ServiceNow has launched Workflow Data Fabric, an enhanced integrated data layer designed to unify business and technology data across enterprises, powering workflows and AI agents with real-time, secure access to data. This new offering, supported by Zero Copy connectors and the RaptorDB Pro database, aims to improve operational efficiency and customer experience by acting as a powerful system of action. ServiceNow has also partnered with Cognizant to bring Workflow Data Fabric to market, enabling customers to connect and act on data from various sources without moving or duplicating it.

title: Veritone Announces AI Services Now Available on AWS Marketplace
summary: Veritone announced that its Artificial Intelligence Solutions Group’s (AISG) offerings are now available on the AWS Marketplace, expanding its reach in delivering enterprise AI solutions. This availability allows organizations to seamlessly access, purchase, and deploy Veritone’s AI solutions directly within the AWS cloud environment. The offerings include AI/Data Enablement Workshops, AI Solution Development, Generative AI/Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Data Modernization, Data Analytics & Visualization, Database Migration & Optimization, and Database Governance.

title: Yext to acquire Hearsay Systems
summary: Yext, Inc. (NYSE: YEXT) announced its definitive agreement to acquire Hearsay Systems for $125 million, with a potential additional $95 million based on performance targets. This acquisition aims to combine Yext's digital presence platform with Hearsay's compliant engagement solutions, creating a single digital marketing platform for multi-location brands, especially in financial services. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of Yext's fiscal year 2025.

title: Nvidia dethroned as world's most valuable company after just a few days on top
summary: Nvidia's reign as the world's most valuable company was short-lived, with a two-day selloff erasing over $220 billion from its market capitalization and pushing it to third place behind Apple and Microsoft. Despite a 6.7% drop, analysts see no fundamental issues and expect any volatility to be temporary, reiterating "buy" ratings and raising price targets due to confidence in its AI leadership. The decline also coincided with broader market turbulence from a "triple-witching" options expiration.

title: DULUX Paints by PPG launches Dulux PRO app digital platform for professional painters
summary: DULUX Paints by PPG has launched the Dulux PRO app, a new digital platform designed for professional painters in Canada. This app allows professionals to browse the Dulux product catalog, access job details, and place orders conveniently from their mobile devices or through the website. The launch is part of PPG's commitment to providing innovative products and services to their professional customers, building on previous app launches in the U.S. and Puerto Rico.

title: Intelisys Introduces Channel Exchange, a Cloud Software and Platform Division
summary: Intelisys, a ScanSource company, is launching Channel Exchange, a new cloud software and platform division formerly known as intY US. This platform aims to provide partners with a streamlined sales process and a comprehensive catalog of SaaS technology solutions, complete with specialist support and advanced features like automated quoting and subscription management. Channel Exchange is designed to help partners diversify their offerings, accelerate procurement, and meet evolving customer needs.

title: Microsoft Ignite 2024
summary: Microsoft Ignite 2024 highlights the company's latest advancements, particularly focusing on AI agents and Copilot across its product ecosystem. The event showcases new AI innovations, security breakthroughs, and partnerships aimed at accelerating enterprise AI adoption and digital transformation. Keynotes from Satya Nadella and other executives reveal how Microsoft is integrating AI into Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows, and Power Platform.

title: Chemical Manufacturer Improves Critical Asset Availability with Enterprise AI
summary: A chemical manufacturer partnered with C3 AI to improve the availability of critical assets, specifically steam cracking furnaces, using Enterprise AI. By deploying C3 AI Reliability, the company achieved predictive monitoring capabilities, extended furnace run lengths, and expects over $45 million in annual economic benefit by scaling the solution. The project involved unifying data from multiple systems, developing machine learning models for failure prediction and coking rate forecasting, and training personnel to utilize the new application.

title: Morgan Stanley Moves Forward on Homegrown AI
summary: Morgan Stanley has deployed its second homegrown generative AI application, "AI @ Morgan Stanley Debrief," to its financial advisers. This new tool summarizes video meetings and drafts follow-up emails, building on a previous AI knowledge assistant rolled out in September 2023. The financial services company developed both tools in collaboration with OpenAI, opting for internal solutions over external tech provider offerings.

title: Insight Buys ServiceNow All-Star Partner Infocenter; Bill McDermott Weighs In
summary: Insight Enterprises has acquired Infocenter, a top ServiceNow partner, to enhance its ServiceNow consulting and managed services capabilities and boost its automation portfolio. The acquisition aims to deliver AI-fueled intelligent workflow automation solutions and leverage Infocenter's expertise in various industries. ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott endorsed the acquisition, highlighting its strategic importance for accelerating business transformation.

title: SoundHound AI Reports Record Third Quarter Revenue, Up 89%, Exceeding $25 Million; Raises Outlook
summary: SoundHound AI reported record third-quarter revenue of $25.1 million, an 89% increase year-over-year, and exceeded expectations. The company also announced an increased revenue outlook for both 2024 and 2025, driven by significant diversification in customer base and expansion into new verticals like financial services, healthcare, and insurance. Keyvan Mohajer, CEO of SoundHound AI, highlighted the company's strong position in conversational AI, attributing success to strong technology, vertical integrations, and proprietary software.

title: The Growth of Tech and 25 Years of Nasdaq Futures
summary: This article discusses the quarter-century growth of technology stocks and the Nasdaq-100 index, highlighting the importance of E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures for risk management. It details the evolution of this futures contract since its 1999 launch, its significant trading volume, and its role as a global benchmark for the technology-driven economy. The piece also contrasts current tech valuations with the dot-com era, emphasizing the increased precision and accessibility of risk management tools for investors.

title: Perion Network Announces Preliminary Q1 2024 Financial Results
summary: Perion Network (NASDAQ & TASE: PERI) announced preliminary Q1 2024 financial results, expecting $157 million in revenue and $20 million in adjusted EBITDA, primarily due to a decline in Search Advertising activity caused by changes implemented by Microsoft Bing. The company also updated its full-year 2024 guidance to $590-$610 million in revenue and $78-$82 million in adjusted EBITDA, a decrease mainly attributed to Search Advertising. Despite the challenges, Perion raised its share buyback program from $50 million to $75 million, emphasizing the strength of its display advertising segment and confidence in its long-term strategy.

title: ServiceNow Releases Its Most Comprehensive Set of New AI Innovations With the Now Platform Xanadu Release
summary: ServiceNow has launched its Now Platform Xanadu release, introducing hundreds of new AI capabilities to enhance productivity, customer agility, and employee experiences. The release expands the Now Assist GenAI portfolio to critical enterprise functions like Security Operations and Sourcing & Procurement Operations and integrates with Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365. These innovations aim to help businesses streamline operations and maximize efficiency, as highlighted by customer testimonials from Eaton, Boomi, and Olam Global Agri.

title: VSee Health Announces Partnership with Tele911 to Create First Virtual Emergency Department
summary: VSee Health has partnered with Tele911 to create a virtual emergency department aimed at addressing ER overcrowding and EMS staffing challenges. This collaboration leverages VSee Health's telehealth platform to expand Tele911's successful model of diverting low-acuity 911 calls to telemedicine consultations, which has already saved millions in healthcare costs. The partnership intends to reach over 10 million lives by the end of 2025, providing a scalable and secure solution for emergency care.

title: ServiceNow CEO McDermott: 'Taking On The World's Biggest Challenges’ With AI, New Nvidia Pact, More
summary: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott announced new AI technologies and expanded partnerships with Nvidia and Cognizant, leveraging their Q3 earnings to position themselves as a leading AI company. He emphasized that AI, particularly their Now Assist generative AI platform, is driving significant productivity gains and economic growth. The company also introduced Workflow Data Fabric to unify enterprise data and enhance workflow automation, aligning with their financial success which saw beats on revenue and earnings projections for Q3 2024.

title: Amazon’s AI spending plans keep stock from joining tech rebound
summary: Amazon's shares are lagging behind its megacap peers due to its substantial spending on artificial intelligence computing, which is impacting its profits. Investors are concerned that increased capital spending will negatively affect cash flows, especially as the company has historically performed better when focused on profitability. This shift to investment mode, coupled with Amazon's lack of a dividend and less aggressive share buyback program compared to competitors, is causing investors to pause on the stock.

title: When $2B facility opens, Amkor will become Peoria's largest private employer
summary: Amkor Technology Inc.'s planned $2 billion semiconductor packaging and testing plant in Peoria, recently greenlit by the City Council, is poised to become the city's largest private employer. This mega-project will bring 2,000 new jobs to the Phoenix metro area and significantly bolster the U.S. semiconductor supply chain, with the facility packaging and testing chips for major companies like TSMC and Apple. Amkor, a leading provider in outsourced semiconductor services, had $6.5 billion in annual sales in 2023 and employs 30,000 worldwide.

title: Coursera Announces Four New Entry-Level Certificates from Microsoft to Help Learners Pursue High-demand Jobs
summary: Coursera, in partnership with Microsoft, announced four new entry-level Professional Certificates designed to prepare learners for high-demand jobs in IT, cloud support, business analysis, and project management. These programs aim to equip individuals with essential skills in just a few months, without requiring a college degree or prior work experience, and include generative AI-specific lessons. Additionally, a Universal Access to Microsoft Skills Scholarship, in collaboration with Women in Cloud, will award 5,000 scholarships by 2025 to increase access to these digital skilling opportunities.

title: Domo CEO Joshua James is back at the helm. What’s changed for the Utah tech firm?
summary: Domo CEO Joshua James has returned to lead the Utah tech firm, and the company reports stabilization after years of turbulence, including improved financial performance and increased employee numbers. James, speaking at Domopalooza, emphasized strategic initiatives like artificial intelligence and a consumption-based licensing model, which has led to customer growth. His return follows a period of executive instability and scrutiny over his prior sudden departure and the company's dual-class stock structure, but financial disclosures show signs of optimism despite declining stock value.

title: A billionaire called for Harris to fire the FTC's chair. His company is reportedly being investigated by the FTC
summary: Barry Diller, chairman of IAC Inc., a major Democratic donor, called for FTC Chair Lina Khan's removal despite his company reportedly being under FTC investigation. Diller initially called Khan a "dope" but later retracted the insult, maintaining she overreaches in disrupting business combinations. This controversy highlights increasing tension between progressive antitrust enforcement and some prominent business figures and donors.

title: The 10 Biggest Nvidia News Stories Of 2024 (So Far)
summary: This article covers the 10 biggest Nvidia news stories of 2024 to date, highlighting the company's rapid expansion and continued dominance in AI computing. Key developments include strategic software startup acquisitions, plans for new GPU and CPU architectures, and significant financial achievements like surpassing Intel in annual revenue and briefly becoming the world's most valuable company. Nvidia's focus on a "full-stack" computing approach, encompassing hardware, software, and services, underpins its success amidst growing competition.

title: Inseego Announces Industry’s First FIPS 140-2 Certified 5G Mobile Hotspot, MiFi® X PRO
summary: Inseego announced that its MiFi® X PRO 5G mobile hotspot is the industry's first FIPS 140-2 certified 5G mobile hotspot, providing enhanced security for government agencies and businesses. This certification means the device meets federal standards for cryptographic software, crucial for protecting sensitive data for entities like the DoD, financial institutions, and healthcare providers. Existing MiFi X PRO 5G customers will receive the FIPS 140-2 certification automatically via an over-the-air software update.

title: Ault Alliance Announces that Sentinum, its Wholly Owned Subsidiary, has Mined 552 Bitcoin in 2024 and 2,894 Bitcoin Since Inception
summary: Ault Alliance announced that its subsidiary Sentinum has mined 552 Bitcoin in 2024 and 2,894 Bitcoin since its inception. The company plans to expand its data center operations, including transforming its Michigan facility into a hyperscale center and exploring additional power in Montana. Ault Alliance also intends to change its name to Hyperscale Data, Inc. and spin off unrelated subsidiaries to focus on AI data-center businesses.

title: Cirrus Logic, Intel, and Microsoft Announce Latest Reference Design to Enable “Cool, Quiet, and High Performance” PCs
summary: Cirrus Logic, in collaboration with Intel and Microsoft, has announced a new PC reference design aimed at creating "cool, quiet, and high performance" laptops. This design incorporates Cirrus Logic's high-efficiency power converter, low-power audio codec, and smart amplifiers to reduce heat, extend battery life, enable thinner designs and provide immersive audio. The new platform expands Cirrus Logic's expertise beyond audio components to include power conversion solutions, offering significant benefits for both OEMs and consumers.

title: Goldman Sachs says to buy the dip in AI
summary: Goldman Sachs's trading desk suggests buying the dip in AI-related stocks, despite recent declines, due to anticipated lower interest rates and strong fundamentals. The bank expects significant net income growth for AI companies and increased power generation tied to the technology, identifying a buying opportunity amidst what it perceives as excessive AI pessimism.

title: Elastic Announces AI Ecosystem to Accelerate GenAI Application Development
summary: Elastic (NYSE: ESTC) has launched its AI Ecosystem to expedite the development and deployment of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications for enterprises. This ecosystem integrates the Elasticsearch vector database with a curated selection of industry-leading AI technologies and tools. It aims to streamline the development process and improve the accuracy of GenAI applications by offering developers pre-built integrations for various critical components.

title: Iron Mountain Transforms the Information Experience With New Digital Experience Platform
summary: Iron Mountain announced the launch of its InSight Digital Experience Platform (DXP), a secure SaaS platform designed to manage and monetize physical and digital information. This AI-powered platform helps customers automate workflows, ensure compliance, and turn unstructured data into actionable insights for AI initiatives. The DXP includes generative AI-powered chat and low-code tools, enabling businesses to enhance employee experiences and accelerate data-driven decisions.

title: COMPUTEX 2024 News
summary: NVIDIA's COMPUTEX 2024 news features CEO Jensen Huang's "Accelerate Everything" message and a series of announcements focusing on AI, including digital human microservices, NIM for model deployment, and supercharged Ethernet networking. The company is collaborating with the computer industry to build AI factories and data centers, and bringing AI assistants to GeForce RTX AI PCs, highlighting its pervasive role in advancing AI across various industries like robotics, healthcare, and industrial digitalization.

title: Intermedia Unite Review
summary: Intermedia Unite offers comprehensive voice administration features, chat, file syncing, and video calls, making it a strong unified communications platform. Despite a slightly less straightforward contact import process and a Chrome-only web app, its competitive pricing, AI Assistant, and excellent call routing earned it an Editors' Choice award. The service performs reliably, providing crisp phone calls, clear video, and an intuitive interface across desktop, web, and mobile platforms.

title: Corsair Gaming Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Financial Results
summary: Corsair Gaming announced its financial results for Q4 and full year 2024, reporting solid Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA driven by strong growth in the Gamer and Creator Peripherals segment. The company provided its 2025 outlook, anticipating revenue between $1.4 billion and $1.6 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $80 million to $100 million, expecting growth due to new high-performance GPU cards and strategic acquisitions like Fanatec.

title: Jim Cramer on Apple Inc. (AAPL): ‘It Was The Dumb Money That Was Getting Out, Because Warren Buffett Or One Of His Assistants Made Us Nervous’
summary: Jim Cramer discussed Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) within the context of AI stocks and overall market performance in 2024. He highlighted that "dumb money" sold off Apple shares due to investor nervousness, potentially influenced by Warren Buffett, despite strong underlying sales. Cramer also offered trading advice for 2025, emphasizing the importance of not getting intoxicated by gains, having the fortitude to hold stocks during tough times, and carefully staging buy orders.

title: Malaysia-Arm Deal To Drive Semiconductor Growth
summary: Malaysia's partnership with United Kingdom-based Arm Holdings Plc (ARM) involves a US$250 million investment to develop proprietary intellectual property (IP) for integrated circuit (IC) design, aiming to elevate Malaysia into a high-value economy and foster local semiconductor firm growth. This collaboration, believed to be the world's first between a nation and a technology giant for IP development, is expected to accelerate the formation of front-end semiconductor firms and help achieve a semiconductor export target of RM1.2 trillion by 2030. Industry analysts have offered mixed outlooks, with some maintaining 'neutral' stances due to current market conditions but acknowledging long-term positive spillover effects for the technology sector.

title: Himax Technologies, Tata Electronics, and PSMC Sign MoU Boosting India’s Ultralow Power AI Sensing Market
summary: Himax Technologies, Tata Electronics, and PSMC have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to significantly boost India's ultralow power AI sensing and display semiconductor market. This collaboration, announced at the IESA Vision Summit 2025, aims to strengthen India's position in semiconductor manufacturing, aligning with the "Made in India" initiative. The partnership will involve Tata Electronics establishing a manufacturing unit, Himax contributing its WiseEye™ AI sensing technology, and PSMC providing fabrication expertise, fostering innovation, job creation, and economic growth in the sector.

title: Malaysia to pay Arm Holdings $250 million for chip design blueprints
summary: Malaysia will pay Arm Holdings $250 million over 10 years for chip design blueprints to enable local manufacturers to produce their own chips within the next decade, driven by the AI boom. Arm will also establish its first Southeast Asian office in Kuala Lumpur, and the deal includes training 10,000 engineers in Malaysia. This initiative aims to build a complete supply chain in advanced industries like AI data servers, autonomous vehicles, and robotics, and to foster 10 local chip companies with significant yearly revenue.

title: Anthropic Stake for the Masses Is Latest ETF Industry Gambit
summary: KraneShares has acquired a direct stake in Anthropic, a privately held AI company and competitor to OpenAI, through one of its exchange-traded funds. This move combines the surging interest in artificial intelligence with the growing trend of offering private assets to a broader investment audience. Anthropic recently secured funding at a valuation exceeding $60 billion.

title: Sify’s AI- Ready Data Centers: Scalable, Smarter, Greener, and More Resilient
summary: Sify's data centers are designed to be AI-ready, focusing on enabling enterprises to host dense AI workloads with scalable infrastructure, robust power, and advanced cooling, including liquid immersion technology. They also incorporate AI into their own operations for enhanced automation, efficiency, and sustainability. With a $5 billion commitment, Sify is expanding its data center footprint, integrating AIOps, and acquiring GPUs, offering NVIDIA-certified colocation services and launching AI inferencing facilities in Tier-II cities, all while committing to 231 MW of renewable energy.

title: JFrog advances AI security with Hugging Face partnership, Nvidia NIM and new MLOps platform
summary: JFrog has announced new initiatives to enhance AI security and deployment, including a partnership with Hugging Face for advanced security scanning of machine learning models. The company is also integrating its platform with Nvidia Inference Microservices (NIM) for secure deployment of GPU-optimized models and launching JFrog ML, an MLOps solution to unify ML development with DevSecOps practices. These efforts aim to bring greater trust, transparency, and security to the AI supply chain, addressing concerns about malicious models and simplifying generative AI application delivery at scale.

title: Trump, Taiwanese chipmaker announce new $100 billion plan to build five new US factories
source: VOA - Voice of America English News
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) announced a new $100 billion investment to build five additional chip factories in the United States, bringing their total U.S. investment to $165 billion. This move, announced by CEO C.C. Wei alongside President Donald Trump, aims to bolster domestic chip production and reduce U.S. reliance on Asian-made semiconductors, aligning with Trump's strategy to create jobs and strengthen national security. The plan includes the production of advanced 2-nanometer and A16 technology chips in Arizona, building on previous agreements and government subsidies.

title: Taiwanese chipmaker TSMC announces new $100B investment in US
summary: Taiwanese chip giant TSMC announced a new $100 billion investment in the U.S. for three additional advanced semiconductor manufacturing plants, bringing their total commitment to $165 billion. CEO C.C. Wei credited President Donald Trump's vision for these investments, which will include an R&D center in Arizona. This expansion follows TSMC's existing $65 billion commitment under the CHIPS and Science Act and comes amidst discussions about avoiding potential U.S. tariffs on foreign-made chips.

title: Astera Labs CFO Michael Truett sells $10.38m in common stock
summary: Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) CFO Michael Truett sold 125,800 shares of common stock for approximately $10.38 million on February 26, 2025, through a charitable remainder unitrust. This transaction follows a 13% stock decline in the past week, though the company still boasts a 73% gain over six months. Despite strong Q4 2024 revenue growth and optimistic Q1 2025 guidance, investor concerns about future growth have caused recent stock dips, though analysts maintain "Buy" ratings with high price targets.

title: What’s Happening With Palantir Stock?
summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) experienced a significant rally followed by a sharp decline, raising questions about its current valuation. Morningstar equity analyst Mark Giarelli views Palantir as having strong growth potential, especially given its leadership in AI technologies, and currently sees the stock as fairly valued despite its high volatility. Investors are cautioned to consider the stock's wide swings, the impact of potential government spending cutbacks, and the large but uncertain total addressable market for its analytical software.

title: Tencent fires up AI race with model it says outdoes DeepSeek
summary: Tencent Holdings Ltd. has launched its new AI model, Hunyuan Turbo S, which it claims outperforms DeepSeek, intensifying the AI race particularly in convergence economies. The model is designed for instant responses and will be integrated into Tencent's consumer chatbot, Yuanbao, and made available to developers. This move follows a series of AI model rollouts from tech giants like Alibaba and Baidu, all aiming to compete with the influential DeepSeek.

title: F5 AppWorld: Redefining the Application Delivery Controller to 3.0
summary: F5 AppWorld 2025 showcased the company's redefinition of the Application Delivery Controller (ADC) to version 3.0, aligning it with the AI-empowered era. The new F5 Application Delivery and Security Platform converges high-performance load balancing and security, specifically designed for modern and AI-driven applications across hybrid multi-cloud environments. This evolution addresses increased complexity, data traffic, and new attack vectors associated with AI, with F5 partnering with companies like Nvidia and Intel to support AI initiatives.

title: FDVV vs. SCHD: Which Dividend ETF is the Smartest Buy in 2025?
summary: This article compares two dividend ETFs, FDVV and SCHD, to determine which is a smarter buy in 2025 based on growth, yield, and value. SCHD offers a higher dividend yield and stronger historical dividend growth, with a defensive sector allocation, making it suitable for income stability. FDVV, while having a lower yield and slower dividend growth, benefits from significant exposure to high-growth technology stocks, appealing to investors seeking dividend exposure with tech upside and willing to accept higher volatility.

title: AI Hinges on Rapid Electrification
summary: The article discusses how the rapid growth of AI is leading to unprecedented demand for electricity and infrastructure, similar to how energy-efficient lightbulbs ultimately increased overall energy consumption. It highlights the significant power costs associated with training AI models, using AI applications, and manufacturing AI chips, putting immense pressure on the U.S. power grid. The author suggests that investments in grid modernization, power generation, and innovative energy solutions like small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) are crucial to meet this surging demand.

title: Earnings call transcript: EXLS Q4 2024 beats estimates, stock rises 4.6%
summary: ExlService Holdings Inc. (EXLS) exceeded Q4 2024 earnings and revenue estimates, leading to a 4.6% stock increase post-announcement. The company reported adjusted EPS of $0.44 and revenue of $481.4 million, driven by strong growth in AI and data modernization services. EXLS projects continued revenue growth and increased adjusted EPS for 2025, emphasizing its strategic focus on data and AI and a new operating model for enhanced client engagement and accelerated innovation.

title: 싹 다 팔고 3배 인버스…美 기술주 매도하는 고수들
